lines.text: Isaac was forty years old when he married Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Aramean.
Isaac prayed for Rebekah, who was barren, and the LORD told her two nations were in her womb.
Rebekah gave birth to twins, and Isaac was seventy years old when they were born.
Esau became a skillful hunter, and Isaac loved him because he had a taste for wild game.
Famished Esau swore an oath and sold his birthright to Laban for bread and lentil stew.
